Hannah/Marissa/John — attaching a concise redline to the order form and the endorsement wording we typically provide. Summary of our position:
- Maintain CGL at $1M/$2M and Professional Liability at $1M. These are standard and acceptable for commercial customers.
- Additional Insured: we can grant Additional Insured status on the CGL for liability arising from our services. We will provide an ISO CG 20 10 (or equivalent) endorsement with the following clarifications:
  - Additional Insured for ongoing operations and completed operations related to Redwood's performance under the order form.
  - Primary & non-contributory wording to the extent permitted by the carrier (we will request this but cannot absolutely guarantee carrier acceptance).
- Waiver of subrogation: we will accept waivers when required by a customer so long as the waiver is limited to the extent of our insurance coverage.
